sketch:
Observe: single-slope (or SAR) ADC schematic; input analogue
voltage feeds a comparator + counter. Student sweeps V_e and reads
the resulting N-bit binary code; step-size = V_ref / 2^N is
highlighted. A time-vs-count animation shows conversion latency.
Experiment: sample a live sine — student picks (f_s, N) to
reproduce it faithfully on a reconstruction plot. Evaluate: given
a bit stream, deduce the original V_e(t). Wrinkle: quantization
noise floor visible on a small spectrum inset — bridges to the
spectrum analyzer exercise.
